entities.name: Yazid of Morocco
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mawlay al-Yazid bin Mohammed, born on 6 May 1750 in Fes and died on 23 February 1792 near Zagora, was a Sultan of Morocco from 1790 to 1792, a ruler of the 'Alawi dynasty. He was proclaimed sultan after the death of his father Mohammed bin Abdallah.
